pages.text: Tanks store fluids between the machines that make them and the machines that use them. A tank is a handy buffer: it keeps the flow going when production dips.

There are two kinds. Each holds a single fluid:$(br)$(li)the $(l)Liquid Tank$() (a steel line around the glass, waves on its lid) takes liquids: water, lava, Coolant, Cryo Coolant, Acid and the liquids of other mods;
$(li)the $(l)Gas Tank$() (a mint line around the glass, a cloud on its lid) takes gases: biogas, methane, Steam and the gases of other mods.

$(l)Tanks grow.$() Blocks of the same kind that fill a box join into one tank: a column, a row, a 2x2x2, a 3x3x3, up to 16 blocks on a side. Each block adds $(l)32 buckets$(), and pipes and buckets see the whole box as one tank.$(br)$(li)Tanks already holding different fluids don't join.
pages.title: Building bigger tanks

pages.text: $(li)A joined tank has one frame around its outside and one pane of glass on each side, however many blocks it has.

$(li)$(l)Fill$() a tank with the matching pipe: a $(l:cables/liquid_pipe)Liquid Pipe$(/l) or a $(l:cables/gas_pipe)Gas Pipe$(/l). It plugs into any free face of any block, top and bottom too. A collar (steel on the Liquid Tank, mint on the Gas Tank) shows where a pipe plugs in.
pages.title: Filling and emptying

pages.text: $(li)Tanks are $(l)passive$(): they never push anything out. To $(l)empty$() one into a machine, right-click the arm of the pipe that touches it, so the pipe $(l)pulls$() from the tank. A lit band round the pipe's end shows it (see $(l:cables/cables)Cables$(/l)).
$(li)$(l)Buckets$() work too: right-click a tank with a bucket to fill it or to take a bucket out. The Gas Tank takes gas buckets.

$(li)Through the glass you see the fluid standing up to its level, in its own colour. Gases look hazy.$(br)$(li)$(l)Look at a tank$() to see a panel over it with what is inside and how full it is, one panel for a whole joined tank.
pages.title: Reading the level

pages.text: $(li)$(l)Shift + right-click$() a tank, with anything in hand, to read the exact amount.
$(li)$(l)Per block$(): 32,000 mB (32 buckets)$(br)$(li)$(l)Largest side of a joined tank$(): 16 blocks
pages.title: Numbers

pages.text: $(li)Put a tank between a $(l:generators/methane_extractor)Methane Extractor$(/l) and the Gas Turbines, or between a $(l:basics/water_pump)Water Pump$(/l) and a $(l:nuclear/fission_reactor)Fission Reactor$(/l).$(br)$(li)Breaking a block $(l)loses what that block held$(). The rest stays in the other blocks, which join up again where they can.
pages.title: Tips

pages.text: $(li)A tank built across a chunk border gives and takes nothing while only part of it is loaded (far from every player, or at the edge of what a drone's Anchor Addon keeps loaded). It works again as soon as the rest is loaded.
